g.text: INDIA DPDP ACT 2025 COMPLIANCE & 7-DAY ERASURE PIPELINE
Section 12 Patient Right to Erasure · ops/dpdp_delete.py · Multi-Hop Graph Traversal & Cryptographic Suppression
From customer consent revocation or privacy request to irreversible cryptographic erasure within statutory 7 days
THE 3-TIER DATA TAXONOMY & TARGET RESOLUTION MATRIX
Granular separation of unrecoverable hard deletion, slot capacity reclamation, and lawful financial audit exceptions
Purges all patient WhatsApp chat transcripts & voice notes
Deletes conversational state machine histories & intents
Removes patient name, phone number, and WhatsApp identity
Removes appointment rows, waitlist entries, and staff alerts
Zero residual patient PII in production replica sets
Unlinks appointment without destroying practitioner calendar

text.tspan: Erasing a patient must not collapse the clinic's
capacity. The slot automatically returns to "open"
status, allowing waitlisted patients to claim it.

g.text: No dangling foreign keys to deleted booking.
Financial transaction ledger retained for GST & PMLA statutory tax compliance
Immutable operational ledger preserved without PII

text.tspan: Data Fiduciary retains financial records strictly
as mandated by Indian tax and accounting laws,

g.text: DPDP ACT 2025 COMPLIANCE SPECIFICATION · DATA FIDUCIARY ARCHITECTURAL ASSURANCE

text.tspan: Calculates exact impact counts across all collections
before a single byte is deleted. Execution requires
explicit authorized_by staff identity for the audit log.
The final completion record in erasure_requests
scrubbed counts. Proves full statutory compliance
without storing the patient's data as evidence.
Explicit tracking of downstream deletion requests
for Meta WhatsApp, Exotel telephony, Sarvam AI,
and Razorpay. Ensures data is purged across
all data processors under Section 8(4) & Section 12.
